scope: The complete actual default-state class, not all field meanings or an approved key. Source decisions are review findings, not code-derived semantic labels.

rows.name: earnings_per_share
rows.reason: The full source pairs the current EPS with the prior reported and prior adjusted EPS. Both source-supported measurement readings have the same direction. Does unresolved choice of one numeric prior justify reported state, or can the state be settled without inventing a measurement or comparator? Keep the expectation twin distinct from the temporal comparison.

Separately, the prior guidance is explicitly approximate but the actual is exact. Reconcile the existing comparison operand with the never-drop modifier rule and the matching-home rule, without falsely qualifying the actual or inventing a per-operand field. A lawful cautious representation and its existing ambiguity note are acceptable; do not force numeric precision.
